Description.SourceString:
These purple stones are a wonder to behold. The way the light catches them and sparkles - it can delight even the smallest of children for many hours.

It was for this reason that it’s been sought after by artisans everywhere. Or possibly because of its inherent magical properties?

Nah, must be the distracting kids things. I’ve spoken to parents, a little quiet time seems like it’s worth its weight in gold.
